summary: This is a Simple Agreement for Future Equity (SAFE) issued by YayYo, Inc., a Delaware corporation, to an investor in exchange for a Purchase Amount paid within two business days of signing. The instrument grants the investor the right to receive SAFE Preferred Stock and later Conversion Shares, accruing an 8% annual dividend until a triggering event. The offering is a Regulation A+ (Tier 2) and Regulation D/S private placement capped at $5,000,000, ending by the earlier of the Regulation A+ offering's completion or June 30, 2017. Conversion discounts range from 50% for early purchases down to 10%, then none after February 15, 2017. Triggers include an Equity Financing (automatic conversion), a Liquidity Event (cash-out or conversion), a Dissolution Event (preferred payout), and a forced conversion by December 31, 2017 subject to a $50 million cap. The agreement also contains company and investor representations, accredited-investor certifications, Regulation S provisions, anti-money laundering forms, and California governing law.

This is a Simple Agreement for Future Equity (SAFE) issued by YayYo, Inc., a Delaware corporation, to a named investor in exchange for a Purchase Amount paid within two business days of signing. The instrument grants the investor the right to receive SAFE Preferred Stock and, upon an Equity Financing (such as the company's Regulation A+ Tier 2 offering), conversion shares at a discounted price, with an 8% annual dividend accruing until conversion. The discount scales from 50% for early purchases down to zero after February 15, 2017. Upon a liquidity event the investor may take cash or stock, and on dissolution it receives priority repayment. If no equity financing occurs by December 31, 2017, shares convert automatically subject to a $50 million valuation cap. The agreement includes company and investor representations, Regulation D/Regulation S securities-law certifications, anti-money-laundering forms, and California governing law.

This is a Simple Agreement for Future Equity (SAFE) issued by YayYo, Inc., a Delaware corporation, under Regulation A+ (Tier 2) and Regulation D/S exemptions. Investors pay a Purchase Amount (up to $5,000,000 in total offering) in exchange for rights to receive SAFE Preferred Stock that converts into common stock at a discount (50% to 10% depending on the sale date, with no discount after February 15, 2017), accruing 8% annual dividends. Conversion occurs upon an Equity Financing; in a Liquidity Event investors may take cash or shares; upon dissolution they receive priority repayment; and a forced conversion applies if no event occurs by December 31, 2017, subject to a $50 million valuation cap. The agreement includes company and investor representations, securities-law legends, accredited investor and anti-money laundering certifications, and California governing law.

This is a Simple Agreement for Future Equity (SAFE) issued by YayYo, Inc., a Delaware corporation, to an investor in exchange for a Purchase Amount paid within two business days of the Sale Date. The investor receives rights to SAFE Preferred Stock and later Conversion Shares, accruing an 8% annual dividend until an event occurs. Conversion occurs at a discount to the Regulation A+ offering price, ranging from 50% for early purchases down to 10% by mid-February 2017, and no discount thereafter. Triggers include an equity financing, a liquidity event (with cash or stock options), a dissolution, or a forced conversion by December 31, 2017, subject to a $50 million valuation cap. The agreement contains company and investor representations, securities-law legends, Regulation S and accredited-investor certifications, AML forms, and California governing law.

This is a Simple Agreement for Future Equity (SAFE) issued by YayYo, Inc., a Delaware corporation, under which an investor pays a Purchase Amount in exchange for the right to receive SAFE Preferred Stock and, upon an Equity Financing, Conversion Shares at a discount to the offering price. The discount ranges from 50% for sales on or before December 31, 2016 down to 10% for sales through February 15, 2017, with no discount afterward. The instrument accrues an 8% annual dividend and is tied to the company's Regulation A+ (Tier 2) offering, which ends by the earlier of its completion or June 30, 2017. If no Equity Financing, Liquidity Event, or Dissolution Event occurs by December 31, 2017, the SAFE forcibly converts subject to a $50 million valuation cap. The agreement also contains company and investor representations, accredited investor and Regulation S certifications, anti-money laundering documentation, and a California governing-law clause.

YayYo, Inc. (Delaware) is offering up to $5 million of rights to SAFE Preferred Stock in an unregistered private placement under Reg D Rule 506 and/or Reg S, with resale restrictions. The SAFE accrues an 8% annual dividend and carries a purchase discount that falls from 50% for sales through December 31, 2016 to none after February 15, 2017. On a Regulation A+ Tier 2 or IPO equity financing, the purchase amount plus dividends converts automatically into common stock at the discounted price. A liquidity event lets the investor choose cash or shares, and dissolution repays investors ahead of stockholders. If no qualifying event occurs by December 31, 2017, forced conversion applies subject to a $50 million cap. Investors have no stockholder rights until shares issue and must certify accredited, sophisticated, or non-U.S. status and complete anti-money-laundering forms.
